**Configuration:**
- The session cookie name is `session_token`.
- Supported library view modes are exactly `grid` and `list`; the default for users with no record is `grid`.
- Supported list sort values are exactly `recent` (default), `oldest`, and `title-asc`; unknown values fall back to `recent`.
- Title length is 1 to 200 characters inclusive after trimming; whitespace-only titles are treated as empty.
- Description length is 0 to 2000 characters inclusive after trimming.
- The web app proxies `/api/videos`, `/api/videos/{id}`, `/api/videos/{id}/retry`, and `/api/users/me/preferences` to the backend while preserving request cookies and response bodies.
- The detail-page route used by card click navigation is `/app/videos/{id}`.
- F04 provides a deterministic local-storage failure mechanism (configuration flag, env var, or test-only override) that forces the next filesystem cleanup of a designated video to fail without relying on F07.

## HTTP API

**Verification mode:** Send an HTTP request to the running service; assert response status, headers, body, and any direct persisted side-effect.

### Library

**Common given:** `library-user` has an active `session_token` cookie and the seeded library videos exist with their declared statuses and timestamps.

#### `API-LIBRARY-01` — list returns every owned video with library card shape
- given: (default)
- when: GET `/api/videos` with the active session cookie
- then:
  - response status is 200
  - body videos include every seeded `library-user` video and only those (`lib-video-ready`, `lib-video-validating`, `lib-video-transcribing`, `lib-video-summarizing`, `lib-video-failed`, `lib-video-renamable`, `lib-video-describable`, `lib-video-deletable`, `lib-video-delete-cleanup-failure`, `lib-video-retry-noop`)
  - each entry contains the library card metadata shape (id, title, originalFilename, fileSizeBytes, durationSeconds, containerFormat, status, failureReason, thumbnailUrl, thumbnailState, uploadedAt)
  - `lib-video-failed` entry's failureReason is "Transcription service unavailable"

#### `API-LIBRARY-02` — default sort is most recent first
- given: (default)
- when: GET `/api/videos` without a `sort` query parameter and with the active session cookie
- then:
  - response status is 200
  - body videos are ordered with the newest `uploadedAt` first
  - `lib-video-ready` (oldest seeded) appears after `lib-video-validating` (newer)

#### `API-LIBRARY-03` — `sort=oldest` reorders ascending by uploadedAt
- given: (default)
- when: GET `/api/videos?sort=oldest` with the active session cookie
- then:
  - response status is 200
  - body videos are ordered with the oldest `uploadedAt` first
  - `lib-video-ready` appears before `lib-video-validating`

#### `API-LIBRARY-04` — list excludes other users' videos
- given: (default)
- when: GET `/api/videos` with the active session cookie
- then:
  - response status is 200
  - no entry has the id of `other-user-video`

#### `API-LIBRARY-05` — list requires authentication
- given: no `session_token` cookie is sent
- when: GET `/api/videos`
- then:
  - response status is 401
  - body code is `unauthenticated`

### Rename

**Common given:** `library-user` has an active `session_token` cookie.

#### `API-RENAME-01` — valid title updates the video
- given: (default), and `lib-video-renamable` has title "Old Title"
- when: PATCH `/api/videos/{lib-video-renamable.id}` with body `{ "title": "New Title" }` and the active session cookie
- then:
  - response status is 200
  - body video title is "New Title"
  - the persisted video title for `lib-video-renamable` is "New Title"
  - the persisted updatedAt is newer than the prior updatedAt

#### `API-RENAME-02` — empty or whitespace title is rejected
- given: (default)
- when: PATCH `/api/videos/{lib-video-renamable.id}` with body `{ "title": "   " }` and the active session cookie
- then:
  - response status is 400
  - body code is `invalid_video_title`
  - body message identifies the offending title value
  - the persisted title for `lib-video-renamable` is unchanged

#### `API-RENAME-03` — title above 200 characters is rejected
- given: (default), and the candidate title is a string of 201 characters
- when: PATCH `/api/videos/{lib-video-renamable.id}` with that title and the active session cookie
- then:
  - response status is 400
  - body code is `invalid_video_title`
  - body message names the 200-character upper bound
  - the persisted title for `lib-video-renamable` is unchanged

#### `API-RENAME-04` — renaming another user's video returns not found
- given: (default), and the target video is `other-user-video` (owned by `other-user`)
- when: PATCH `/api/videos/{other-user-video.id}` with body `{ "title": "Hijack" }` and `library-user`'s active session cookie
- then:
  - response status is 404
  - body code is `video_not_found`
  - the persisted title for `other-user-video` is unchanged

### Description

**Common given:** `library-user` has an active `session_token` cookie.

#### `API-DESCRIBE-01` — valid description updates the video
- given: (default), and `lib-video-describable` has description ""
- when: PATCH `/api/videos/{lib-video-describable.id}` with body `{ "description": "Notes for next week." }` and the active session cookie
- then:
  - response status is 200
  - body video description is "Notes for next week."
  - the persisted description for `lib-video-describable` is "Notes for next week."

#### `API-DESCRIBE-02` — description above 2000 characters is rejected
- given: (default), and the candidate description is a string of 2001 characters
- when: PATCH `/api/videos/{lib-video-describable.id}` with that description and the active session cookie
- then:
  - response status is 400
  - body code is `video_description_too_long`
  - body message names the 2000-character upper bound
  - the persisted description for `lib-video-describable` is unchanged

### Delete

**Common given:** `library-user` has an active `session_token` cookie.

#### `API-DELETE-01` — confirmed delete removes row and on-disk artifacts
- given: (default), and `lib-video-deletable` has both an original file and a thumbnail file at stable internal paths
- when: DELETE `/api/videos/{lib-video-deletable.id}` with the active session cookie
- then:
  - response status is 204
  - no `videos` row exists for that id
  - no original file exists at that video's prior storage path
  - no thumbnail file exists at that video's prior thumbnail path

#### `API-DELETE-02` — second delete returns not found
- given: `lib-video-deletable` has already been deleted by an earlier call
- when: DELETE `/api/videos/{lib-video-deletable.id}` with the active session cookie
- then:
  - response status is 404
  - body code is `video_not_found`

#### `API-DELETE-03` — deleting another user's video returns not found
- given: (default), and the target video is `other-user-video`
- when: DELETE `/api/videos/{other-user-video.id}` with `library-user`'s active session cookie
- then:
  - response status is 404
  - body code is `video_not_found`
  - the persisted `other-user-video` row is unchanged

#### `API-DELETE-04` — filesystem cleanup failure does not block deletion
- given: (default), and the configured F04 deterministic-cleanup-failure mechanism is armed for `lib-video-delete-cleanup-failure`
- when: DELETE `/api/videos/{lib-video-delete-cleanup-failure.id}` with the active session cookie
- then:
  - response status is 204
  - no `videos` row exists for that id
  - a structured-JSON warning log entry has been emitted naming the orphaned files and the video id

### Retry

**Common given:** `library-user` has an active `session_token` cookie.

#### `API-RETRY-01` — retry resets a failed video to validating
- given: (default), and `lib-video-failed` has status `failed` with failure reason "Transcription service unavailable"
- when: POST `/api/videos/{lib-video-failed.id}/retry` with the active session cookie
- then:
  - response status is 200
  - body video status is `validating`
  - the persisted status for `lib-video-failed` is `validating`
  - the persisted failureReason for `lib-video-failed` is null

#### `API-RETRY-02` — retry on a non-failed video is rejected
- given: (default), and `lib-video-retry-noop` has status `ready`
- when: POST `/api/videos/{lib-video-retry-noop.id}/retry` with the active session cookie
- then:
  - response status is 409
  - body code is `video_not_failed`
  - the persisted status for `lib-video-retry-noop` is `ready`

### Preferences

#### `API-PREFS-01` — fresh user receives grid as the default view mode
- given: `fresh-user` has an active `session_token` cookie and no preference row
- when: GET `/api/users/me/preferences` with the active session cookie
- then:
  - response status is 200
  - body preferences libraryViewMode is `grid`
  - no `user_preferences` row has been created as a side-effect of the read

#### `API-PREFS-02` — updating the view mode persists the new value
- given: `library-user` has an active `session_token` cookie and a preference row with `grid`
- when: PATCH `/api/users/me/preferences` with body `{ "libraryViewMode": "list" }` and the active session cookie
- then:
  - response status is 200
  - body preferences libraryViewMode is `list`
  - the persisted preference row for `library-user` has libraryViewMode `list`

#### `API-PREFS-03` — invalid view mode is rejected
- given: `library-user` has an active `session_token` cookie
- when: PATCH `/api/users/me/preferences` with body `{ "libraryViewMode": "carousel" }` and the active session cookie
- then:
  - response status is 400
  - body code is `invalid_library_view_mode`
  - body message identifies "carousel" as the offending value and names the accepted set
  - the persisted preference row for `library-user` is unchanged

## UI

**Verification mode:** Render the surface, drive it with user-like inputs (clicks, typing, gestures); assert observable surface state (DOM, accessibility tree, visible text, navigation).

### Library Render

**Common given:** the browser is authenticated as `library-user` and the seeded library videos exist.

#### `UI-LIBRARY-RENDER-01` — grid view shows every owned video with metadata from upload
- given: (default), and the persisted library view mode for `library-user` is `grid`
- when: render `/app`
- then:
  - the page shows every seeded `library-user` video as a grid card
  - each card shows the video title and the duration label
  - `lib-video-ready` shows its extracted thumbnail
  - `lib-video-validating` shows the placeholder thumbnail state
  - no card belongs to `other-user`

#### `UI-LIBRARY-RENDER-02` — list view shows every owned video as a compact row
- given: (default), and the persisted library view mode for `library-user` is `list`
- when: render `/app`
- then:
  - the page shows every seeded `library-user` video as a compact row
  - each row shows the video title, duration, upload date, and file size
  - the active view-mode control indicates `list` as the current mode

#### `UI-LIBRARY-RENDER-03` — status badges cover all five processing states with distinct treatments
- given: (default), and `library-user` has at least one video in each of `validating`, `transcribing`, `summarizing`, `ready`, `failed`
- when: render `/app`
- then:
  - each card shows a status badge whose label matches its video's status (`lib-video-validating` → `validating`, `lib-video-transcribing` → `transcribing`, `lib-video-summarizing` → `summarizing`, `lib-video-ready` → `ready`, `lib-video-failed` → `failed`)
  - the five badge variants are visually distinguishable (not all rendered with the same class or color token)

### View Mode

#### `UI-VIEW-MODE-01` — toggle to list persists across reload
- given: the browser is authenticated as `library-user` and the persisted library view mode is `grid`
- when: open `/app`, click the list-view toggle control, then reload the page
- then:
  - immediately after the click, the library renders in list view
  - after reload, the library still renders in list view
  - the persisted preference row for `library-user` has libraryViewMode `list`

#### `UI-VIEW-MODE-02` — first visit defaults to grid
- given: the browser is authenticated as `fresh-user` and there is no preference row for `fresh-user`
- when: render `/app`
- then:
  - the library renders in grid view
  - the active view-mode control indicates `grid` as the current mode

### Sort

#### `UI-SORT-01` — sort selector reorders the library
- given: the browser is authenticated as `library-user` and `/app` is open in grid view
- when: open the sort control and select "Oldest"
- then:
  - the library re-renders with `lib-video-ready` (oldest) before `lib-video-validating` (newer)
  - the active sort control reflects the "Oldest" selection

### Rename

#### `UI-RENAME-01` — rename dialog accepts a new title and updates the card
- given: the browser is authenticated as `library-user`, `/app` is open, and `lib-video-renamable` is visible with title "Old Title"
- when: open `lib-video-renamable`'s card menu, choose "Rename", type "New Title", and submit
- then:
  - the dialog closes
  - the `lib-video-renamable` card shows title "New Title"
  - the persisted title for `lib-video-renamable` is "New Title"

#### `UI-RENAME-02` — empty or whitespace title is rejected inline
- given: the browser is authenticated as `library-user`, `/app` is open, and the rename dialog for `lib-video-renamable` is open
- when: clear the title input (or fill it with whitespace) and attempt to submit
- then:
  - the dialog stays open
  - an inline message identifies that the title cannot be empty
  - no PATCH request is sent
  - the persisted title for `lib-video-renamable` is unchanged

### Description

#### `UI-DESCRIBE-01` — description modal saves up to 2000 characters
- given: the browser is authenticated as `library-user`, `/app` is open, and the description dialog for `lib-video-describable` is open
- when: type a 1500-character description and submit
- then:
  - the dialog closes
  - the persisted description for `lib-video-describable` matches the typed text
  - the visible character counter showed a value not exceeding 2000 while typing

### Delete

**Common given:** the browser is authenticated as `library-user` and `/app` is open with `lib-video-deletable` visible.

#### `UI-DELETE-01` — confirmation modal disables Delete for one second
- given: (default)
- when: open `lib-video-deletable`'s card menu and choose "Delete"
- then:
  - a confirmation modal appears with text that includes the title "Soon To Be Deleted" and the wording "This cannot be undone."
  - the Delete button is disabled at the moment the modal opens
  - the Delete button becomes enabled approximately one second after the modal opens
  - the Cancel button is enabled immediately

#### `UI-DELETE-02` — cancel closes the modal without a request
- given: (default), and the delete confirmation modal for `lib-video-deletable` is open
- when: click "Cancel"
- then:
  - the modal closes
  - the `lib-video-deletable` card remains visible
  - no DELETE request is sent
  - the persisted `lib-video-deletable` row is unchanged

#### `UI-DELETE-03` — confirmed delete removes the card from the library
- given: (default), and the delete confirmation modal for `lib-video-deletable` is open with the Delete button enabled
- when: click "Delete"
- then:
  - the modal closes
  - the `lib-video-deletable` card disappears from the library
  - no `videos` row exists for `lib-video-deletable`

#### `UI-DELETE-04` — concurrent delete surfaces the inline message
- given: (default), and a stale UI delete affordance for `lib-video-deletable` is still present after another tab has already deleted that video
- when: confirm delete on the stale affordance
- then:
  - a visible message reads "This video has already been deleted"
  - no `videos` row exists for `lib-video-deletable`
  - the stale card affordance is removed from the library

### Retry

#### `UI-RETRY-01` — retry on a failed video transitions the badge to validating
- given: the browser is authenticated as `library-user`, `/app` is open, and `lib-video-failed` is visible with status badge `failed`
- when: open `lib-video-failed`'s card menu and choose "Retry"
- then:
  - the `lib-video-failed` card status badge changes to `validating`
  - the persisted status for `lib-video-failed` is `validating`
  - the retry action is no longer offered in the same card's menu

### Empty Library

#### `UI-EMPTY-01` — empty library shows illustration, copy, and upload zone
- given: the browser is authenticated as `fresh-user` and `fresh-user` has no videos
- when: render `/app`
- then:
  - the page shows a recognizable illustration element marked with an image role
  - the page shows the copy "Upload your first video to get started"
  - the page shows the upload drop zone introduced by F03
  - no video card is rendered

### Card Open

#### `UI-OPEN-01` — clicking a card navigates to the detail route
- given: the browser is authenticated as `library-user`, `/app` is open, and `lib-video-ready` is visible
- when: click the `lib-video-ready` card body (not its menu trigger)
- then:
  - the browser navigates to `/app/videos/{lib-video-ready.id}`

## E2E

**Verification mode:** Run the full system; drive it the way a real user would; assert cross-stack behavior.

### Library

#### `E2E-LIBRARY-01` — uploaded video metadata renders end-to-end in the library
- given: the browser is authenticated as `library-user` and the seeded library videos exist
- when: open `/app`
- then:
  - the page lists every seeded `library-user` video
  - `lib-video-ready` appears with its title "Alpha Lecture", an extracted thumbnail, the duration "60s" or its formatted equivalent, and the upload date
  - `lib-video-validating` appears with its placeholder thumbnail state and a `validating` status badge
  - no `other-user` video is rendered

### View Mode

#### `E2E-VIEW-MODE-01` — view mode persists across a real session restart
- given: the browser is authenticated as `library-user`, `/app` is open in grid view, and the persisted preference is `grid`
- when: click the list-view toggle, close the browser context, reopen it as the same authenticated `library-user`, and visit `/app`
- then:
  - the library renders in list view in the new browser context
  - the persisted preference row for `library-user` has libraryViewMode `list`

### Delete

#### `E2E-DELETE-01` — confirmed delete removes the video everywhere
- given: the browser is authenticated as `library-user`, `/app` is open, and `lib-video-deletable` is visible with its on-disk original and thumbnail present
- when: open `lib-video-deletable`'s card menu, choose "Delete", wait for the Delete button to enable, and confirm
- then:
  - the `lib-video-deletable` card disappears from the library
  - reloading `/app` does not bring the card back
  - no `videos` row exists for `lib-video-deletable`
  - the prior original file and thumbnail file no longer exist on disk
